sentences.text: 4. On the matter being taken up, learned counsel for the applicant has not pressed the relief as sought by means of this application on merit and prayed for issuance of appropriate direction to the concerned Courts below to decide the bail application of the applicant expeditiously.
5. Learned A.G.A. has no objection in allowing the aforesaid prayer of the applicant.
6. Accordingly the relief as sought by the applicant through this application is refused.

7. Considering the aforesaid alternative prayer of the applicant, it is directed that if applicant surrenders before the concerned Court below within three weeks from today and applies for bail, the bail application shall be decided expeditiously by the courts below in accordance with law laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in 2021 SCC OnLine SC 922.
8.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in 2021 SCC OnLine SC 922
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: For the period of three weeks from today or till the time of surrender of the applicant before the Court below, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against him.
9. With the aforesaid directions, this anticipatory bail application U/s 438 Cr.P.C., stands disposed of.
